for x in rows:
 b=Path(x['path']).read_bytes();assert len(b)==x['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==x['sha256'],x['path']
assert len(rows)==31
class H(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.refs=[];self.ids=[];self.tags=[];self.images=[];self.events=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,t,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs);self.tags.append(t)
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  for k,v in attrs:
   if k in ('src','href'):self.refs.append((t,k,v))
   if k.startswith('on'):self.events.append((t,k,v))
  if t=='img':self.images.append(a)
a=(p/'baseline/ARTIST-WARDROBE.html').read_text();b=(p/'candidate/ARTIST-WARDROBE.html').read_text();ha=H();hb=H();ha.feed(a);hb.feed(b)
assert not (set(hb.tags)&{'script','canvas','iframe','object','embed'}) and not hb.events
assert len(hb.ids)==len(set(hb.ids))
assert Counter(ha.refs)<=Counter(hb.refs)
new=list((Counter(hb.refs)-Counter(ha.refs)).elements());links=[]
for t,k,u in new:
 if u.startswith('#'):assert hb.ids.count(u[1:])==1;links.append({'tag':t,'attribute':k,'reference':u,'fragment_resolves':True});continue
 assert u.startswith('/@fs/'),u
 f=Path(unquote(urlsplit(u).path[len('/@fs'):]))
 assert f.is_file() and not f.is_symlink(),str(f)
 q=f.read_bytes();links.append({'tag':t,'attribute':k,'reference':u,'path':str(f),'bytes':len(q),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(q).hexdigest()})
imgs=[]
for x in hb.images:
 u=x['src'];assert u.startswith('/@fs/');f=Path(unquote(urlsplit(u).path[len('/@fs'):]))
 q=f.read_bytes();assert len(q)<=8*1024*1024 and x.get('alt');imgs.append({'path':str(f),'bytes':len(q),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(q).hexdigest()})
assert len(imgs)==9 and sum(x['bytes'] for x in imgs)==9512872 and sum(x['bytes'] for x in imgs)<32*1024*1024
assert len(b.encode())<32*1024
assert ha.tags.count('article')==8 and hb.tags.count('article')==9
assert 'Four character directions. Five 3D drafts.' in b and b.count('id="mara-cardigan-draft"')==1
ca=(p/'baseline/PROJECT-CHECKLIST.md').read_text();cb=(p/'candidate/PROJECT-CHECKLIST.md').read_text()
assert ca.split('## Outstanding',1)[1]==cb.split('## Outstanding',1)[1]
newrow='- [x] Editable standalone Mara cardigan 3D artist blockout with six reviewed mesh views and JSON/OBJ/MTL; unitless and unfitted, with finished cloth, sewing, body fit, rigging, motion and runtime use still open. [Mesh, exports, views and limits](evidence/appearance-2026-10-19/mara-cardigan-attachment-index/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)\n\n'
assert cb.count(newrow)==1
assert cb.replace(newrow,'').replace('sewing, finished 3D clothing, body fit','sewing, 3D, body fit')==ca
assert [len(re.findall(r'^- \[x\]',z,re.M)) for z in [ca,cb]]==[22,23]
assert all(len(re.findall(r'^- \[ \]',z,re.M))==10 for z in [ca,cb])

 old=(p/'baseline'/n).read_bytes();newb=(p/'candidate'/n).read_bytes();assert (r/'docs'/n).read_bytes()==old
 g=subprocess.run(['git','show','2dafce7a:docs/'+n],cwd=r,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=5,check=True);assert g.stdout==old

 parts.append(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.decode().splitlines(True),newb.decode().splitlines(True),fromfile='baseline/'+n,tofile='candidate/'+n)))
